items.title: IonQ大漲5%量子運算再突破 攜手輝達推升股價
items.title_en: IonQ surges 5% as quantum computing breakthrough and partnership with Nvidia lift stock
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，IonQ(IONQ-US)股價周三(23日)大漲5%，此前公司宣布量子運算領域取得突破，並與AI晶片大廠輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)展開新的合作。
IonQ宣布將把名為Superion 256的量子電腦安裝在輝達位於波士頓的加速量子研究中心(Accelerated Quantum Research Center)，並直接連接至這家AI晶片巨頭的基礎設施。
IonQ董事長暨執行長Niccolo de Masi在聲明中表示，「我們認為，這是混合量子－經典運算令人振奮的時代起點。」
兩家公司將利用這套系統進行金融模型與投資組合最佳化研究，以及用於藥物開發的化學研究。
IonQ股價同樣受到周二宣布的一項技術突破提振。該公司表示，其系統現在能夠利用單一標準CPU偵測並修正錯誤。
IonQ表示，這項突破「消除了容錯量子運算的一大瓶頸」。
量子運算類股今年以來波動劇烈。IBM(IBM-US)、D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US)、Rigetti Computing(RGTI-US)與Infleqtion(INFQ-US)4月宣布已與美國商務部簽署意向書，將獲得研究與開發計畫的資金，帶動量子運算股大幅上漲。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that IonQ (IONQ-US) shares jumped 5% on Wednesday (the 23rd) after the company announced a breakthrough in quantum computing and a new collaboration with AI chip giant Nvidia (NVDA-US).
IonQ said it will install its quantum computer called Superion 256 at Nvidia’s Accelerated Quantum Research Center in Boston, directly connecting to the AI‑chip giant’s infrastructure.
IonQ chairman and CEO Niccolo de Masi said in a statement, "We believe this marks the exciting beginning of the hybrid quantum‑classical computing era."
The two companies will use the system to research financial models and portfolio optimization, as well as chemical research for drug development.
IonQ’s stock was also buoyed by a technical breakthrough announced on Tuesday, with the company saying its system can now detect and correct errors using a single standard CPU.
IonQ said the breakthrough "removes a major bottleneck for fault‑tolerant quantum computing."

Quantum‑computing stocks have been highly volatile this year. IBM (IBM-US), D‑Wave Quantum (QBTS-US), Rigetti Computing (RGTI-US) and Infleqtion (INFQ-US) announced in April that they signed letters of intent with the U.S. Department of Commerce to receive funding for research and development, driving a sharp rally in quantum‑computing equities.

items.title: 「記憶體不缺」成空頭新論據 大賣空貝瑞加碼放空美光、Nebius
items.title_en: "Memory Not Scarce" Becomes New Bearish Thesis, Burry Expands Short on Micron, Nebius
paras: 電影《大賣空》真實原型、知名空頭投資人麥可貝瑞 (Michael Burry)再度擴大對半導體及AI相關股票的看空布局，將記憶體供給可能快速增加視為核心交易邏輯。貝瑞近日在Substack發文表示，他進一步加碼做空美光科技 (MU-US)、Nebius Group (NBIS-US)、iShares半導體ETF (SOXX)及Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US)，並形容這批新增空頭部位「規模不小」。
貝瑞此次加碼的直接背景，是宏碁 (2353-TW) 董事長暨執行長陳俊聖近期對記憶體供需的判斷。陳俊聖指出，部分主流記憶體產品的供應狀況已經改善，DDR4甚至出現「賣家多於買家」的情況，同時中國大陸記憶體業者持續增加產能，可能對市場價格形成壓力。貝瑞在9月22日的交易更新中引用這番說法，並表示雖然該消息是在記憶體股大漲前發布，因此解讀仍存在不確定性，但其內容「與我所相信的判斷相吻合」。
陳俊聖的看法與目前部分記憶體業者對供需前景的說法存在差異。他表示，DDR4及主流DDR5的供應已不像市場普遍認知般緊張，真正仍處於短缺狀態的主要是部分高階產品，例如LPDDR5X-9600等。宏碁同時預期，受到記憶體、SSD等關鍵零組件成本高漲影響，PC產品價格在2026年第4季仍可能上漲約5%至20%，而整體PC價格可能在2027年年中左右觸頂，之後於下半年開始回落。
貝瑞的核心論點，是目前記憶體市場的供應緊張部分來自產能配置錯位，而不完全是需求永久性提升所造成。他認為，隨著三星電子、SK海力士及美光等主要供應商為滿足AI資料中心對高頻寬記憶體(HBM)的強勁需求，部分傳統DRAM產能被轉移至HBM，使一般DRAM供應一度受到擠壓。
在貝瑞的判斷中，隨著記憶體廠商逐步恢復傳統DRAM產能，加上中國記憶體業者持續擴大供應，「正常RAM」產量將逐漸回升，原本的供需缺口可能收窄，並進一步轉化為價格下行壓力。近期中國記憶體產業的擴張也提供了這項論點的背景。中國長鑫存儲科技(CXMT)近期宣布第五代記憶體晶片平台已進入量產，並推出24Gb LPDDR5X產品；該平台透過製程改進，使單片晶圓的晶粒產量較上一代至少提高50%。
CXMT的擴產並非單一事件。路透近期報導指出，CXMT正計畫進一步進軍NAND Flash市場，以因應AI伺服器帶動的記憶體需求，並將與三星電子、SK海力士及美光等主要業者形成更直接的競爭。這意味著中國記憶體產能的增加，可能成為未來全球供需平衡的重要變數。
不過，市場對記憶體供應是否已經進入全面反轉階段仍存在明顯分歧。路透近期報導指出，一些較小型的手機及筆電業者仍在為至少持續至2027年的記憶體短缺做準備，部分業界預期供需失衡甚至可能延續至2030年以後。SK海力士也曾警告，2027年可能是產能供應最吃緊的一年。
與此同時，市場對美光的基本面預期仍然強勁。美光最近公布的財報顯示，財政第3季營收達414.6億美元，遠高於去年同期的93億美元，毛利率更達84.6%；公司預估財政第4季營收約500億美元，並預定在9月30日公布財報。這些數據顯示，當前記憶體價格與AI需求仍為美光帶來強勁的營收及獲利動能，也是貝瑞空頭論點需要面對的市場背景。
貝瑞對半導體產業的看空布局也並非近期才開始。2026年6月底，他已公開揭露放空輝達 (NVDA-US)、應用材料 (AMAT-US)及iShares半導體ETF，並將SOXX相關看跌選擇權展期至2027年3月。當時他也認為AI及半導體類股的上漲已經累積相當大的估值風險。
到了7月初，貝瑞進一步直接放空美光，揭露的進場價格約為每股1,051.87美元。他當時表示，美光看跌選擇權的權利金過於昂貴，因此選擇直接建立股票空頭部位，並稱若未來波動率下降、選擇權價格變得更合理，才可能進一步透過看跌期權增加押注。
這次新增部位則讓貝瑞的看空範圍進一步延伸至AI基礎設施業者Nebius及更廣泛的半導體ETF。貝瑞不只押注單一記憶體企業，也透過SOXX將交易延伸至整體半導體產業，同時維持對Palantir的空頭曝險。
值得注意的是，貝瑞近期對半導體市場的判斷並非單純認為AI需求會消失，而是認為資金可能從半導體類股轉向其他科技領域。他在最新交易文章中指出，記憶體短缺與AI採用的敘事正在吸收市場大量資金，並認為半導體類股可能出現資金輪動。不過，他也承認主要指數持續創新高，使得短期內直接判斷市場頂部並不容易。
市場實際走勢則暫時沒有完全配合貝瑞的空頭押注。9月22日，美光股價收漲5%至1,096.16美元，Nebius上漲約1.43%至236.12美元，Palantir上漲約1.04%至184.99美元，SOXX則上漲約2.4%至572.78美元。也就是說，貝瑞宣布加碼空頭部位後，相關資產當天反而普遍走高。
散戶情緒同樣呈現與貝瑞不同的方向。Stocktwits資料顯示，美光的零售投資人情緒由中性轉為看多，SOXX的散戶情緒也位於看多區間；Nebius同樣呈現偏多情緒，只有Palantir的散戶情緒偏空。美光股價在9月22日上漲5%至1,096.16美元，9月以來累計漲幅約14%。
不過，到了9月23日盤中，市場反應開始出現分化。Palantir一度上漲約2%，Nebius則下跌約2%，美光一度下跌約1%，SOXX下跌約1%，顯示投資人並未以一致方向回應貝瑞的最新交易。
因此，貝瑞與市場目前真正的分歧，並非AI需求是否存在，而是AI需求成長速度能否持續高於記憶體供給擴張速度。若HBM需求持續吸收大量產能，傳統DRAM供應恢復速度可能受到限制；反之，如果中國新增產能、既有記憶體廠恢復一般DRAM產能的速度超過需求增長，價格就可能面臨更大壓力。
這也使2027年成為市場觀察記憶體週期的重要時間窗口。宏碁方面預期PC價格可能在2027年年中左右觸頂、下半年開始回落；部分記憶體業者及產業研究則認為AI伺服器需求仍可能讓供應持續吃緊。
對貝瑞而言，這場交易最終押注的是記憶體供需週期能否由短缺轉向供應增加，而不是單純押注AI產業需求消失。隨著CXMT等中國供應商擴產、三星電子、SK海力士及美光持續調整HBM與傳統DRAM之間的產能配置，以及AI資料中心持續拉動HBM需求，未來記憶體價格究竟會延續高檔，還是如貝瑞所預期般在供應增加後轉跌，將成為半導體市場下一階段的重要觀察焦點。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the famed short-seller whose story inspired the movie "The Big Short," is again widening his bearish bets on semiconductor and AI‑related stocks, using the prospect of a rapid increase in memory supply as the core of his trade. In a recent Substack post, Burry said he is adding short positions in Micron Technology (MU‑US), Nebius Group (NBIS‑US), the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) and Palantir Technologies (PLTR‑US), describing the new shorts as "not small in size."

The immediate trigger for Burry's latest add‑on was the recent comments by Acer (2353‑TW) chairman and CEO Chen Jun‑sheng on memory supply‑demand. Chen said that supply of several mainstream memory products has improved, with DDR4 even seeing "more sellers than buyers," and that Chinese memory makers are continuing to add capacity, which could pressure prices. Burry quoted this in his September 22 trading update, noting that the comment came before a big rally in memory stocks, so its interpretation is uncertain, but that it "matches the judgment I hold."

Chen's view differs from that of some memory makers on the supply‑demand outlook. He said DDR4 and mainstream DDR5 are not as tight as the market generally believes; the real shortages are limited to high‑end products such as LPDDR5X‑9600. Acer also expects that, because of rising costs for memory, SSDs and other key components, PC prices could rise 5%‑20% in Q4 2026, with overall PC pricing possibly peaking around mid‑2027 and then falling in the second half of the year.

Burry's core argument is that the current tightness in the memory market stems partly from a misallocation of capacity rather than a permanent surge in demand. He believes that major suppliers such as Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are shifting some traditional DRAM capacity to high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) to meet strong AI data‑center demand, squeezing ordinary DRAM supply.

In Burry's view, as memory makers gradually restore traditional DRAM output and Chinese producers keep expanding supply, "normal RAM" production will rise, narrowing the supply‑demand gap and creating downward price pressure. Recent expansion in China's memory industry underpins this thesis. China’s CXMT recently announced that its fifth‑generation memory chip platform has entered mass production and launched a 24‑Gb LPDDR5X product; process improvements boost wafer‑level chip output by at least 50% over the previous generation.

CXMT's capacity boost is not an isolated event. Reuters reported that CXMT plans to move further into the NAND‑Flash market to meet AI‑server‑driven memory demand, putting it in more direct competition with Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. This suggests that China's growing memory capacity could become a key variable in the global supply‑demand balance.

However, market participants remain divided on whether memory supply has fully turned around. Reuters noted that some smaller smartphone and laptop makers are still preparing for a memory shortage that could last at least until 2027, with some industry voices warning the imbalance could extend beyond 2030. SK Hynix has also cautioned that 2027 may be the year of the tightest capacity supply.

At the same time, expectations for Micron's fundamentals remain strong. Micron's latest earnings showed Q3 revenue of $41.46 billion, far above last year’s $9.3 billion, with a gross margin of 84.6%. The company forecasts Q4 revenue of roughly $50 billion and will release its next earnings report on September 30. These figures indicate that current memory prices and AI demand are still driving robust revenue and profit momentum for Micron, a backdrop Burry must contend with.

Burry's bearish stance on the semiconductor sector is not new. By the end of June 2026 he had publicly disclosed short positions in Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF, and rolled over SOXX put options to March 2027. At that time he argued that AI‑related and semiconductor stocks had accumulated significant valuation risk.

In early July, Burry went further by shorting Micron directly, entering at about $1,051.87 per share. He said Micron’s put premiums were too expensive, so he chose to establish a naked short position, adding that he might increase exposure via puts if volatility fell and option prices became more reasonable.

The new positions extend Burry’s short exposure to AI‑infrastructure player Nebius and the broader semiconductor ETF. He is not only betting against a single memory company but also using SOXX to target the entire semiconductor industry while maintaining a short on Palantir.

It is worth noting that Burry’s recent view of the semiconductor market is not that AI demand will disappear, but that capital may rotate out of semiconductor stocks into other tech areas. In his latest trading note he said the narrative of memory shortages and AI adoption is soaking up a lot of market money, and that semiconductor equities could see a capital rotation. He also acknowledged that major indices are still hitting fresh highs, making short‑term tops hard to pinpoint.

Market action has not fully aligned with Burry’s short bets. On September 22, Micron closed up 5% at $1,096.16, Nebius rose about 1.43% to $236.12, Palantir gained roughly 1.04% to $184.99, and SOXX climbed about 2.4% to 572.78. In other words, the assets he announced he was adding to his short side actually rose on the same day.

Retail sentiment moved in the opposite direction. Stocktwits data show Micron’s retail investor sentiment shifting from neutral to bullish, SOXX’s retail sentiment also in bullish territory, Nebius similarly bullish, while only Palantir’s retail sentiment remained bearish. Micron’s price has risen 5% on September 22 to $1,096.16 and is up about 14% since the start of September.

However, by mid‑day on September 23 the market response began to diverge. Palantir briefly jumped about 2%, Nebius fell roughly 2%, Micron dipped about 1% at one point, and SOXX also slipped about 1%, indicating investors were not moving in lockstep with Burry’s latest trades.

Thus the real split between Burry and the market is not whether AI demand exists, but whether AI‑driven demand growth can stay ahead of the expansion in memory supply. If HBM demand continues to soak up large capacity, the recovery of traditional DRAM supply may be constrained; conversely, if Chinese new capacity and existing memory fabs restore DRAM output faster than demand grows, prices could face stronger downward pressure.

This makes 2027 a key window for watching the memory cycle. Acer expects PC prices to peak around mid‑2027 and then fall in the second half of the year; some memory makers and industry analysts believe AI‑server demand could keep supply tight.

For Burry, the trade ultimately bets on whether the memory supply‑demand cycle can shift from shortage to oversupply, rather than simply betting on the disappearance of AI demand. As Chinese suppliers like CXMT scale up, Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron adjust capacity between HBM and traditional DRAM, and AI data centers keep pulling HBM, the future path of memory prices—whether they stay elevated or fall as Burry predicts after supply ramps up—will be a focal point for the next phase of the semiconductor market.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉Fed官員接連放鷹 黃金挫逾1%逼近一周最低
items.title_en: <Precious Metals After Hours> Fed Officials Keep Hawkish, Gold Slides Over 1% Toward One‑Week Low
paras: 黃金周三(23日)下挫逾1%並逼近一周低點，聯準會(Fed)決策官員釋出鷹派訊號，強化市場對升息的預期並帶動美元攀升至兩個月高點，使不孳息的黃金受打壓。

黃金現貨下跌1.7%，報每盎司4282.53美元，盤中一度觸及9月17日以來最低。
美國黃金期貨收低1.3%，報每盎司4318.40美元。


Zaner Metals副總裁兼資深金屬策略師Peter Grant表示，美元走強對黃金帶來壓力，「Fed會後官員談話相當鷹派，因此市場正逐步反映今年底前至少還會升息一次的預期，這正讓黃金承受壓力。」
美元升至兩個月高點，使以美元計價的黃金對持有其他貨幣的投資人而言更加昂貴。
Fed官員本周釋出鷹派訊號。芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)表示，Fed可能需要把當前能源衝擊視為持續性通膨來源，而非預期這波衝擊會自行消退。
里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)與波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)也都表示，考量通膨疑慮，他們支持Fed上周升息的決定。
這些發言呼應其他Fed官員近期對通膨疑慮的表態，顯示他們對通膨的擔憂正在擴大。
儘管黃金是傳統的通膨避險工具，但由於黃金本身不孳息，利率上升可能降低黃金相較於孳息資產的吸引力。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期10月升息的機率為77%，12月升息的機率則為95%。
美國總統川普周二警告，他可能「徹底摧毀」伊朗，布蘭特原油期貨一度突破每桶100美元，但仍維持在兩周低點附近。
自2月底美以對伊朗戰事爆發以來，金價與油價幾乎呈現反向走勢。隨著能源價格上漲，市場擔憂通膨升溫以及各國央行收緊貨幣政策，黃金因此飽受壓力。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌3.9%，報每盎司64.45美元。
現貨白金下挫5%，報每盎司1741.83美元。
現貨鈀金下跌3.7%，報每盎司1259.24美元。
paras_en: Gold fell more than 1% on Wednesday (the 23rd), edging toward a one‑week low, as Federal Reserve officials signaled a hawkish stance, bolstering expectations of further rate hikes and pushing the dollar to a two‑month high, which weighed on the non‑yielding metal.

Spot gold dropped 1.7% to $4,282.53 an ounce, briefly hitting its lowest level since September 17. U.S. gold futures fell 1.3% to $4,318.40 an ounce. Peter Grant, vice‑president and senior metal strategist at Zaner Metals, said the stronger dollar is pressuring gold, adding that “Fed officials’ post‑meeting comments were quite hawkish, so the market is gradually pricing in at least one more rate hike before year‑end, which is putting pressure on gold.”
The dollar’s rise to a two‑month high makes gold, priced in dollars, more expensive for investors holding other currencies.

Fed officials issued hawkish signals this week. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the Fed may need to treat the current energy shock as a persistent source of inflation rather than expecting the shock to fade on its own.
Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin and Boston Fed President Susan Collins also said, given inflation concerns, they support the Fed’s decision to raise rates last week.
These remarks echo other Fed officials’ recent statements about inflation worries, indicating that concerns about price pressures are widening among policymakers.
Although gold is a traditional inflation hedge, its lack of yield means rising interest rates can make it less attractive relative to income‑producing assets.
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders now see a 77% probability of a rate hike in October and a 95% probability of a hike in December.
U.S. President Donald Trump warned on Tuesday that he might “completely destroy” Iran, sending Brent crude futures briefly above $100 a barrel, though they remained near a two‑week low.

Since the end of February when the U.S. and Israel escalated conflict with Iran, gold and oil prices have moved almost in opposite directions. With higher energy prices, worries about rising inflation and tighter monetary policy worldwide have put pressure on gold.
Other precious‑metal trades: Spot silver fell 3.9% to $64.45 an ounce. Spot platinum dropped 5% to $1,741.83 an ounce. Spot palladium slid 3.7% to $1,259.24 an ounce.

items.title: 美數據火熱、Fed放鷹 10年期美債殖利率升破5.1% 創19年新高
items.title_en: U.S. Data Hot, Fed Hawkish, 10‑Year Treasury Yield Breaks 5.1% to 19‑Year High
paras: 美債週三 (23 日) 遭遇新一波拋售潮，10 年期殖利率一度升至 5.129%，創 2007 年 7 月以來新高。9 月企業活動加速擴張、價格壓力升高，加上聯準會 (Fed) 官員暗示可能繼續升息，促使交易員提高對 10 月升息的押注。
標普全球公布，美國 9 月企業活動連續第 4 個月加速擴張，增速為 2021 年 7 月以來最快，製造業與服務業產出均成長。標普全球市場財智商業經濟學家 Williamson 表示，若排除疫情封鎖解除後的需求反彈，這是 2015 年初以來最顯著的企業活動改善。
經濟走強的同時，企業成本也持續攀升。
標普全球指出，燃料與運輸費用上漲，推動 9 月商品及服務業投入成本增加，整體價格漲幅達 2022 年 10 月以來最高。Williamson 認為，成本上升可能進一步推高未來幾個月的售價與通膨。
數據公布後，市場對 Fed 再度升息的預期升高。CME FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預估 Fed 10 月升息 1 碼的機率，從前一日約 55% 升至近 70%。
美債殖利率隨之攀升。報導所引述的最新報價顯示，10 年期殖利率上升 18.1 個基點至 5.129%；5 年期上升 16.8 個基點至 5.010%，同樣是 2007 年 7 月以來首次突破 5%。30 年期上升 10.7 個基點至 5.410%，對利率政策較敏感的 2 年期則上升 13.1 個基點至 4.908%。
Fed 理事巴爾 (Michael Barr) 也表示，實現長期 2% 通膨目標的風險已增加，因此需要「重新校準貨幣政策」。他支持 Fed 上週升息，並認為在其基本情境下，可能仍須進一步調整政策，才能讓通膨及時回到目標。
油價反彈則為債市增添壓力。原油價格週三結束連續 5 天跌勢，市場對美伊外交取得進展的期待降溫。
川普週二曾表示，美方代表與伊朗代表團談了 3 小時，並形容會談「非常好」；但美國國務卿盧比歐週三表示，他不會將這次會談稱為「重大突破」，而是視為過去對話的延續。伊朗總統裴澤斯基安則表示，伊朗願意對話與談判，但不接受以武力語言施壓。
paras_en: U.S. Treasuries on Wednesday (the 23rd) faced a new wave of selling, with the 10‑year yield briefly climbing to 5.129%, a fresh peak since July 2007. September corporate activity accelerated, price pressures rose, and Fed officials hinted further rate hikes, prompting traders to increase bets on an October hike.

S&P Global reported that U.S. September corporate activity accelerated for the fourth consecutive month, the fastest pace since July 2021, with both manufacturing and services output growing. S&P Global Market Intelligence economist Williamson said that excluding the post‑pandemic demand rebound, this is the most significant improvement in corporate activity since early 2015.
While the economy strengthens, corporate costs continue to climb.

S&P Global noted that higher fuel and transportation costs drove up input costs for goods and services in September, with overall price increases reaching the highest level since October 2022. Williamson believes the cost rise could further push up prices and inflation in the coming months.

After the data release, market expectations for another Fed hike rose. The CME FedWatch tool showed traders’ probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in October climbing from about 55% the day before to nearly 70%.

Treasury yields rose accordingly. The latest quotes cited in the report show the 10‑year yield up 18.1 basis points to 5.129%; the 5‑year up 16.8 basis points to 5.010%, also breaking above 5% for the first time since July 2007. The 30‑year rose 10.7 basis points to 5.410%, and the rate‑sensitive 2‑year climbed 13.1 basis points to 4.908%.

Fed Governor Michael Barr also said the risk of achieving the long‑term 2% inflation target has increased, requiring a “re‑calibration of monetary policy.” He supported last week’s rate hike and said that under the baseline scenario further policy adjustments may still be needed to bring inflation back to target in a timely manner.
A rebound in oil prices added pressure to the bond market. Crude oil ended a five‑day decline on Wednesday, as market expectations for progress in U.S.–Iran diplomacy cooled.

Trump on Tuesday said the U.S. delegation had a three‑hour meeting with the Iranian team and described it as “very good”; but Secretary of State Antony Blinken on Wednesday said he would not call the talks a “major breakthrough,” viewing them as a continuation of past dialogue. Iran’s President Ebrahim Raisi said Iran is willing to talk and negotiate but will not accept pressure through forceful language.

items.title: 輝達挑戰新高漲勢暫歇 Google AI晶片帶來難題
items.title_en: Nvidia's Challenge to New Highs Pauses as Google AI Chip Poses Problem
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，一個熟悉的問題再次困擾輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)。這家晶片製造商的股價近期再次挑戰歷史新高，但周三(23日)攻勢暫歇，而Google正是問題的一部分。
輝達周三收跌1.4%至225.51美元。該股近期難以突破235.74美元的歷史收盤高點，這項在5月14日創下的紀錄。
部分原因在於整體半導體產業面臨的宏觀經濟因素，費城半導體指數過去3個月下跌5.9%。但輝達也一直需要應對市場對競爭對手蠶食其AI晶片主導地位的疑慮。
最大威脅來自Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google及其TPU，這款晶片是與博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)合作設計。儘管輝達與Google之間的競爭通常相當友好，但投資人仍密切關注大型企業究竟採用哪些晶片。
因此當科技媒體《The Information》報導，Anthropic正洽談向Stream Data Centers租用最高1GW的運算容量，而其中大部分將由TPU提供運算能力，這可能讓市場感到不安。
就在一周前，由10家銀行組成的銀團同意向Crux AI提供220億美元貸款。這家雲端運算新創公司由黑石(Blackstone)與Alphabet支持，這筆資金將用於購買TPU。
不過，這未必是輝達面臨的重大問題。畢竟，Anthropic近期才與雲端服務商Lambda簽署價值350億美元的雲端運算協議，將採用輝達晶片。另據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic也與另一家獲輝達支持的新型雲端服務商Nscale簽署450億美元的協議。
但這再次提醒市場，包括Anthropic在內的大型客戶，正持續設法降低對輝達的依賴。今年8月，Anthropic證實正在組建內部晶片團隊，跟隨ChatGPT開發商OpenAI的腳步。
正如《巴隆》先前報導，輝達正透過支持開源AI社群來反擊，以擴大客戶群。不過，要取代一家Anthropic，需要非常多小型AI公司，而這正是輝達持續面臨的壓力。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that a familiar problem is once again troubling Nvidia (NVDA-US). The chip maker’s stock has recently been testing all‑time highs, but its rally stalled on Wednesday (the 23rd), and Google is part of the issue.
Nvidia closed down 1.4% on Wednesday at $225.51. The shares have struggled to break above the historic closing high of $235.74 set on May 14.

One reason is the broader semiconductor sector’s macro‑economic headwinds, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 5.9% over the past three months. Nvidia also faces concerns that competitors could erode its AI‑chip dominance.

The biggest threat comes from Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google and its TPU, a chip co‑designed with Broadcom (AVGO-US). Although competition between Nvidia and Google is usually fairly friendly, investors are watching closely which chips large enterprises choose.

Thus, when tech outlet The Information reported that Anthropic is negotiating to lease up to 1 GW of compute capacity from Stream Data Centers, most of which will be powered by TPUs, the market grew uneasy.
Just a week earlier, a syndicate of ten banks agreed to lend Crux AI $22 billion. The cloud‑computing startup, backed by Blackstone and Alphabet, will use the funds to purchase TPUs.

However, this may not be a major problem for Nvidia. Anthropic recently signed a $35 billion cloud‑compute deal with Lambda that will use Nvidia chips, and, according to the Wall Street Journal, also signed a $45 billion agreement with Nscale, another new cloud provider backed by Nvidia.

But the episode underscores that large customers, including Anthropic, are actively trying to reduce reliance on Nvidia. In August, Anthropic confirmed it is building an internal chip team, following OpenAI’s path.

As Baron previously reported, Nvidia is fighting back by supporting the open‑source AI community to broaden its customer base. Yet replacing a player like Anthropic would require many small AI firms, a pressure Nvidia continues to face.

items.title: 市場逼宮升息 伊爾艾朗警告：全球央行恐陷危險循環
items.title_en: Markets Push for Rate Hikes, El‑Erian Warns: Central Banks Globally May Enter a Dangerous Cycle
paras: 聯準會上週升息後，市場相對平靜，但知名經濟學家伊爾艾朗（Mohamed El-Erian）擔心，在市場預期推動下，一波危險的升息循環可能正在形成。
身兼安聯（Allianz）首席經濟顧問與品浩（PIMCO）前共同投資長，伊爾艾朗對聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）的演說給予正面評價，不過他本周指出，若聯準會與其他央行持續收緊貨幣政策，恐將衍生出全新問題。
他寫道：「如果這一切成真，市場與經濟都可能陷入困境，原因很簡單：貨幣政策並非應對當前經濟與金融挑戰的最佳工具。」
投資人目前聚焦透過升息抑制通膨，主張緊縮貨幣政策的人士也認為，壓低物價漲勢應是聯準會的首要任務。
但正如伊爾艾朗所言，當市場過度依賴特定結果時，這種聚焦方式反而會為決策官員增添棘手的難題。
就以最近一次的聯準會會議為例，升息機率一度飆破九成，市場觀察家甚至預言，若官員們敢逆勢而為，恐將引發嚴重後果。
他解釋道：「決策機構往往覺得自己受到與交易員之間一種不成文默契的約束：要麼順應市場定價，要麼承擔金融市場波動加劇的風險，而非完全依據經濟基本面作出決策。」
伊爾艾朗認為，這可能讓決策者為維持市場平靜，承擔不必要的風險，甚至犧牲整體經濟的健康。聯準會主席華許將這種情況稱為「鏡廳效應」。
儘管伊爾艾朗並未輕忽壓抑通膨的必要性，但他明確主張，降低通膨的相應措施應由立法機關來推動。
他並警告，若未能落實供需層面的解決方案，美國恐將再次被視為「唯一的解方」，意指市場過度迷信唯有聯準會能拯救經濟問題的心態。
伊爾艾朗回顧，2008年金融海嘯後便曾上演過這般情境，當時政策制定者將大部分因應重責，交給聯準會等監管與技術機構。
他強調：「若焦點持續侷限於貨幣政策，經濟恐將面臨非必要的衰退風險，並將不成比例的沉重負擔轉嫁給最無力承受的族群。這對整體經濟與市場健全發展而言，無疑是莫大的傷害。」
paras_en: After the Fed’s rate hike last week, the market was relatively calm, but renowned economist Mohamed El‑Erian worries that, driven by market expectations, a dangerous cycle of rate hikes may be forming.

El‑Erian, who serves as chief economic adviser at Allianz and is a former co‑chief investment officer at PIMCO, praised Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech, yet he warned this week that if the Fed and other central banks keep tightening monetary policy, new problems could arise.

He wrote: “If this all comes true, both markets and the economy could get stuck in trouble, for a simple reason: monetary policy is not the best tool to address the current economic and financial challenges.”
Investors are currently focused on using rate hikes to curb inflation, and those advocating tighter monetary policy argue that lowering price pressures should be the Fed’s top priority.
But, as El‑Erian notes, when the market over‑relies on a specific outcome, this focus can actually create thorny dilemmas for policymakers.

Take the most recent Fed meeting as an example: the probability of a rate hike at one point surged past 90%, and market observers even warned that if officials dared to go against the trend, severe consequences could follow.

He explained: “Decision‑makers often feel bound by an unwritten pact with traders: either go with market pricing or bear the risk of heightened financial market volatility, rather than basing decisions purely on economic fundamentals.”

El‑Erian believes this may lead policymakers to take unnecessary risks to keep markets calm, even sacrificing overall economic health. Fed Chair Warsh has called this phenomenon the “mirror‑hall effect.”
While El‑Erian does not downplay the need to rein in inflation, he argues that the appropriate measures to lower it should be driven by legislators.

He warns that without supply‑and‑demand solutions, the United States could once again be seen as the “only answer,” meaning the market’s over‑reliance on the Fed as the sole savior of economic problems.
El‑Erian recalls that a similar situation unfolded after the 2008 financial crisis, when policymakers handed most of the heavy lifting to the Fed and other regulatory and technical bodies.

He stresses: “If the focus remains confined to monetary policy, the economy risks an unnecessary recession and will shift a disproportionate burden onto the most vulnerable groups, which would be a grave harm to overall economic and market health.”

items.title: 伊朗提議重開荷姆茲海峽 美方拒絕
items.title_en: Iran Proposes Reopening the Strait of Hormuz, U.S. Rejects
paras: 多家外媒週三 (23日) 報導，美國與伊朗在聯合國大會場邊舉行間接談判期間，伊朗提出重新開放荷姆茲海峽，但遭美方拒絕。美國談判代表表示，德黑蘭並不控制這條水道，並質疑伊朗是否有權提出這項條件。
這場談判在紐約不同房間、分別進行。美國特使魏科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 與川普女婿庫許納 (Jared Kushner) 同處一室，伊朗外交部長阿拉奇 (Abbas Araghchi) 則在另一個房間，由卡達調停人員往返傳話。
伊朗在談判中要求美國於一週內回應其公開提出的條件。
根據伊朗國營媒體 IRIB，德黑蘭的訴求包括立即解除美國的海上封鎖、儘速返還遭凍結的伊朗資產，以及結束針對所有「抵抗陣線」的戰爭。
這是美伊雙方自 6 月中旬以來首輪談判。以色列未派代表參加。以色列今年 2 月底與美國共同對伊朗發動軍事行動，但自 4 月以來大致停止空襲。
報導引述知情人士表示，在聯合國大會結束前，美伊仍可能舉行更多間接會談。不過，調停方正等待美國總統川普決定，是繼續推進談判，還是改採其他途徑。
川普週二在聯合國大會發表演說，對伊朗發出強硬警告，稱德黑蘭若不接受結束戰爭的協議，他可能「殲滅伊斯蘭共和國」，美國國務卿盧比歐週三在紐約告訴記者，川普總統「有很多選擇，包括軍事選項」。
伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian) 週三在第81屆聯合國大會發表演說。
他表示，伊朗願意談判與合作，但不會接受以強權、制裁或軍事威脅迫使其讓步，和平必須建立在公平、正義、尊嚴和各國平等權利的基礎上。
裴澤斯基安強調，伊朗維護國家安全、主權和和平利用核子技術的立場，認為自身防禦力量是避免外部威脅的重要保障，同時否認以霸權方式追求安全。
他批評一些國家在伊朗核問題、以色列及巴勒斯坦問題上的「雙重標準」，認為持續佔領、侵略和不公會加劇地區衝突。佩澤希齊揚表示，戰爭和軍事力量不能取代國際法、外交與政治對話，他呼籲透過區域合作實現共同安全。
布蘭特原油期貨週三上漲 3.83 美元或 3.86%，收在每桶 103.08 美元；西德州原油期貨上漲 1.64 美元或 1.81%，收在每桶 92.16 美元。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported on Wednesday (the 23rd) that during indirect talks between the United States and Iran held beside the UN General Assembly hall, Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz, but the U.S. refused. The U.S. negotiator said Tehran does not control the waterway and questioned whether Iran has the right to set such a condition.

The talks took place in separate rooms in New York. U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and former President Trump’s son‑in‑law Jared Kushner were in the same room, while Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi was in another room, with Qatari mediators shuttling messages between them.
Iran demanded that the United States respond within a week to the conditions it publicly presented.

According to Iran’s state media IRIB, Tehran’s demands include the immediate lifting of the U.S. maritime blockade, the swift return of frozen Iranian assets, and an end to the war against all “resistance fronts.”

This is the first round of talks between the U.S. and Iran since mid‑June. Israel sent no representatives. Israel jointly launched a military operation against Iran with the United States at the end of February, but has largely ceased air strikes since April.

Sources quoted in the report say that more indirect meetings between the U.S. and Iran could still occur before the UN General Assembly adjourns. However, the mediators are waiting for President Trump to decide whether to continue pushing the negotiations forward or to pursue other avenues.

President Trump delivered a speech at the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, issuing a hard‑line warning to Iran that if Tehran does not accept an agreement to end the war, he could “annihilate the Islamic Republic.” U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken told reporters in New York on Wednesday that the president “has many options, including military ones.”
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian spoke at the 81st UN General Assembly on Wednesday.

He said Iran is willing to negotiate and cooperate, but will not accept being forced to concede by power, sanctions or military threats; peace must be built on fairness, justice, dignity and equal rights for all nations.

Pezeshkian emphasized Iran’s stance of safeguarding national security, sovereignty and the peaceful use of nuclear technology, arguing that its own defensive capabilities are a key guarantee against external threats, while denying any hegemonic pursuit of security.

He criticized what he called “double standards” by some countries on Iran’s nuclear issue, as well as the Israel‑Palestine question, saying continued occupation, aggression and injustice will exacerbate regional conflict. Pezeshkian said war and military force cannot replace international law, diplomacy and political dialogue, and called for regional cooperation to achieve collective security.
Brent crude futures rose $3.83, or 3.86%, on Wednesday to close at $103.08 a barrel; West Texas Intermediate crude rose $1.64, or 1.81%, to close at $92.16 a barrel.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至近兩個月高點 Fed短期內升息預期增
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near Two-Month High as Fed Rate-Hike Expectations Increase
paras: 美元周三(23日)大幅上漲，升至近兩個月來最高，因投資人對聯準會(Fed)短期內升息的預期升溫。同時，伊朗對和平談判進展表示懷疑，推動油價大漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.51%，報101.06，盤中一度升至101.23，創7月29日以來最高。
聯準會上周升息25個基點，將利率區間調升至3.75%至4.00%後，多名聯準會官員已表示，如果通膨未能降溫，可能需要進一步升息。
聯準會理事巴爾(Michael Barr)周三表示，美國央行上周採取重要措施，重新「校準」短期借貸成本，以降低通膨，而未來可能還需要進一步升息。
Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，「目前市場關注的就是利率。」
「推動美元走高的是上周聯準會鷹派升息後的延續效應，這為美元帶來新的動能。本周公布的數據不多，與政策相關的數據更少，但有趣的是聯準會官員的談話，他們基本上都在傳達相同訊息，也就是未來還會進一步緊縮。」
在標普全球(S&P Global)公布綜合PMI產出指數初值後，美元漲幅進一步擴大。該指數涵蓋製造業與服務業，本月升至58.4，創2021年7月以來最高，高於8月的56.0。新訂單大幅增加帶動整體活動，但強勁需求也使供應鏈承受壓力，並推升價格。
根據LSEG數據，在上述數據公布後，市場對聯準會10月會議至少升息25個基點的預期升溫，目前機率約為70%，高於數據公布前的約53%。
中東緊張局勢推升油價
進一步推動美元上漲的因素還包括油價走高。伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書Mohsen Rezaei接受伊朗國營電視台訪問時表示，只要伊朗提出的條件沒有獲得滿足，荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)就不會重新開放，也不會進行談判。
此外，一名伊朗高級官員告訴《路透社》，伊朗與美國對如何結束戰爭仍存在重大分歧，但外交努力必須持續。此前，伊朗總統在聯合國大會上表示，德黑蘭永遠不會屈服於美國壓力。
外界原本希望聯合國大會期間的外交活動能促成這場持續7個月的伊朗戰爭達成解決方案，相關希望曾推動油價自9月中觸及4個月高點後回落，但本周市場情勢已出現逆轉。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)表示，聯準會需要「保持謹慎」，並可能需要將目前的能源衝擊視為持續性通膨來源，而不能預期其自行消退。
歐元走弱、日元承壓
歐元兌美元下跌0.51%至1.1389美元，連續第三個交易日走跌，並創一周來最大單日跌幅。
稍早公布的標普全球歐元區綜合PMI產出指數初值顯示，儘管中東與烏克蘭衝突推升企業與家庭的能源成本，但歐元區經濟仍展現出意外的韌性。
投資人也在等待美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平會面，兩大強權目前在貿易、科技以及伊朗戰爭等議題上存在分歧。

paras_en: The dollar surged sharply on Wednesday (the 23rd), reaching its highest level in nearly two months as investors’ expectations for a near‑term Fed rate hike warmed. At the same time, Iran expressed doubts about progress in peace talks, pushing oil prices sharply higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.51% to 101.06, briefly climbing to 101.23 intraday – the highest since July 29.
The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points last week, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%. Several Fed officials have since said that if inflation does not cool, further hikes may be needed.

Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday that the central bank took an important step last week to “re‑calibrate” short‑term borrowing costs to curb inflation, and that additional hikes could still be required.
Elias Haddad, head of global market strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman, said, “The market’s focus right now is on rates.”

“What is driving the dollar higher is the lingering effect of last week’s hawkish Fed hike, which gives the greenback fresh momentum. There are few data releases this week and even fewer policy‑related numbers, but the interesting part is the Fed officials’ remarks – they are essentially delivering the same message: further tightening is likely ahead.”

After S&P Global released the flash composite PMI output index, the dollar’s gains widened further. The index, covering manufacturing and services, rose to 58.4 this month – the highest since July 2021 and above August’s 56.0. Strong new orders lifted overall activity, but robust demand also strained supply chains and pushed up prices.

LSEG data show that after the PMI release, market expectations that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points at its October meeting rose to roughly 70%, up from about 53% before the data were out.
Middle‑East tensions lift oil prices

Another factor pushing the dollar higher is the rise in oil prices. In an interview with Iran’s state TV, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, said that unless Iran’s conditions are met, the Strait of Hormuz will not be reopened and negotiations will not resume.

A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran and the United States still have major disagreements on how to end the war, but diplomatic efforts must continue. Earlier, Iran’s president said at the UN General Assembly that Tehran will never bow to U.S. pressure.

Outside observers had hoped that diplomatic activity during the UN General Assembly would produce a solution to the seven‑month‑long Iran conflict, a hope that had helped oil prices retreat from a four‑month high reached in mid‑September. This week, market sentiment has reversed.

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the Fed needs to “stay cautious” and may have to treat the current energy shock as a persistent source of inflation rather than assuming it will fade on its own.
Euro weakens, yen under pressure
The euro fell 0.51% against the dollar to $1.1389, marking a third consecutive trading‑day decline and the biggest single‑day drop in a week.

A flash composite PMI for the euro area released earlier showed that despite higher energy costs for businesses and households from the Middle‑East and Ukraine conflicts, the European economy displayed unexpected resilience.
Investors are also awaiting a meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, as the two powers remain at odds on trade, technology and the Iran war.
The dollar rose 0.17% against offshore yuan to 6.71 yuan.
The yen weakened 0.52% to 158.19 per dollar.

The Bank of Japan raised rates last week to the highest level in 31 years, but it has not convinced investors that further hikes are coming; traders are watching closely for any sign of intervention in the FX market.
Analysts note that Japan’s market is currently thin on liquidity due to a string of holidays, which could increase the likelihood of authorities stepping in.

items.title_en: KY BizLink Completes $900 Million Acquisition; Interplex Datacom Consolidated, AI Data Center Revenue Scale Expands
paras: 2026年09月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 貿聯-KY BizLink(3665-TW)今日完成收購新加坡Interplex集團資料通訊業務Interplex Datacom，並自9月23日起正式納入合併報表。這筆交易不只是補強產品線，也讓貿聯一次取得資料中心互連技術、精密金屬加工能力及亞洲多地產能，進一步擴大AI資料中心基礎設施布局。
貿聯今年6月簽署收購協議，交易企業價值最高9億美元，其中8.5億美元為現金對價，另包含最高5,000萬美元或有對價，資金來源包括自有現金及花旗集團Citigroup(C-US)提供的承諾債務融資。
從收購規模來看，Interplex Datacom截至2026年3月31日止期間營收達3.92億美元。以最高9億美元企業價值計算，交易價格約為營收的2.3倍；若以8.5億美元現金對價計算，則約為2.2倍。隨9月23日起正式併表，Interplex Datacom也將開始對貿聯營收規模產生直接貢獻。
根據優分析統計，截至2026年9月，貿聯股價營收比已升至5.12倍，也來到歷史相對高檔。隨Interplex Datacom正式併表，市場關注焦點將從營收規模擴大，進一步轉向併購後能否提高AI資料中心業務占比與營收含金量。
更值得關注的是雙方產品與產能的互補性。Interplex Datacom總部位於新加坡，主要提供資料中心客製化互連及高精密機械產品，並在中國大陸、越南、馬來西亞及泰國設有生產據點，員工超過1,900人。
貿聯董事長梁華哲先前表示，Interplex Datacom可補強AI伺服器及機櫃Busbar(匯流排)等產品線，同時快速增加產能。透過整合雙方亞洲製造據點，貿聯可進一步擴充資料中心相關產品的供應能力與全球生產布局。

paras_en: September 23, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – KY BizLink (3665‑TW) completed today the acquisition of Interplex Group’s Singapore‑based data communications business Interplex Datacom and will begin consolidating it into its financial statements as of September 23. The deal not only strengthens its product line but also gives KY BizLink access to data‑center interconnect technology, precision metal‑working capabilities, and multiple production sites across Asia, further expanding its AI data‑center infrastructure footprint.

KY BizLink signed the acquisition agreement in June this year, with an enterprise value of up to US$900 million, of which US$850 million is cash consideration and up to US$50 million in contingent consideration. Funding comes from its own cash reserves and a committed debt facility from Citigroup (C‑US).

Based on the size of the acquisition, Interplex Datacom generated US$392 million in revenue for the period ending March 31, 2026. At the maximum US$900 million enterprise value, the purchase price is about 2.3 times revenue; using the US$850 million cash consideration, it is roughly 2.2 times revenue. With consolidation effective September 23, Interplex Datacom will begin to contribute directly to KY BizLink’s revenue.

According to U‑Analysis statistics, KY BizLink’s price‑to‑sales ratio had risen to 5.12 times by September 2026, reaching a historically high level. With Interplex Datacom now consolidated, market focus will shift from sheer revenue growth to whether the post‑M&A integration can raise the share and profitability of its AI data‑center business.

Equally noteworthy is the complementarity of the two companies’ products and capacities. Interplex Datacom is headquartered in Singapore, primarily offering customized data‑center interconnects and high‑precision mechanical products, and operates manufacturing sites in mainland China, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand with over 1,900 employees.

KY BizLink Chairman Liang Hua‑zhe previously said that Interplex Datacom can reinforce product lines such as AI servers and rack busbars, while quickly adding capacity. By integrating the two firms’ Asian manufacturing sites, KY BizLink can further expand its supply capability for data‑center‑related products and its global production footprint.

items.title_en: MouLian Completes Acquisition of Singapore Interplex Datacom Business, Strengthening Data Center Infrastructure Footprint
paras: 貿聯-KY(3665-TW)今(23)日公告，已與子公司BizLink Speedy Pte. Ltd.共同完成新加坡Interplex集團資料通訊業務(Datacom Business)收購案，將自9月23日起正式納入貿聯合併報表，透過此次收購，將強化公司在資料中心連接技術及基礎設施領域的布局。
貿聯董事長梁華哲日前受訪指出，併購Interplex Datacom業務不僅可補強AI伺服器及機櫃Busbar(匯流排)等產品線，更能快速擴充產能，並透過串聯中國大陸、越南、泰國及馬來西亞等地，強化全球產能布局，將有助後續業務擴張。
貿聯指出，透過整合Interplex Datacom業務，將取得客製化互連解決方案及高精密機械產品方案，並提升相關製造能力，進一步強化整合型資料中心基礎設施布局，推動產品朝更高複雜度及附加價值發展。
此次併購也將提升貿聯精密金屬加工技術及市場地位，相關技術可支援集團設備解決方案事業部，應用於半導體機櫃、醫療設備及系統整合組裝等領域。貿聯強調，本次收購符合長期發展策略，有助提升營運規模、強化市場競爭力及擴大全球布局，後續將持續推動Interplex Datacom業務發展及整合。
Interplex Datacom 總部位於新加坡，是全球領先的資料中心基礎設施創新客製化互連解決方案、高精密機械產品供應商，具備強大的研發能力，並於中國、越南、馬來西亞及泰國設有生產據點，員工人數超過 1,900 人；貿聯於6月宣布以現金收購Interplex Datacom。
paras_en: MouLian-KY (3665-TW) announced today (the 23rd) that it has jointly completed the acquisition of the Datacom Business of Singapore's Interplex Group with its subsidiary BizLink Speedy Pte. Ltd. The business will be formally consolidated into MouLian’s combined financial statements starting September 23, and the purchase will bolster the company’s positioning in data‑center connectivity technology and infrastructure.

Chairman Liang Hua‑zhe told reporters that acquiring Interplex’s Datacom business not only reinforces product lines such as AI servers and rack busbars, but also enables rapid capacity expansion. By linking operations in mainland China, Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia, the deal strengthens MouLian’s global capacity layout and will support future business growth.

MouLian said that integrating Interplex’s Datacom business will give it access to customized interconnect solutions and high‑precision mechanical product offerings, enhancing related manufacturing capabilities. This will further solidify an integrated data‑center infrastructure platform and drive products toward greater complexity and added value.

The acquisition will also elevate MouLian’s precision metal‑processing technology and market standing. The related capabilities can support the group’s equipment solutions division, with applications in semiconductor racks, medical equipment and system‑integration assemblies. MouLian emphasized that the purchase aligns with its long‑term strategy, expanding operational scale, competitiveness and global reach, and it will continue to develop and integrate the Interplex Datacom business.

Interplex Datacom, headquartered in Singapore, is a global leader in innovative, customized interconnect solutions and high‑precision mechanical products for data‑center infrastructure. It boasts strong R&D capacity and operates manufacturing sites in China, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand, employing over 1,900 staff. MouLian announced in June that it would acquire Interplex Datacom for cash.

paras: 燁輝(2023-TW)今(23)日召開重訊，擬參與認購燁聯(9957-TW)私募普通股13.4萬張，每股私募價格6元，投資金額達8.04億元，燁輝目前對燁聯直接持股比例34.05%，本次認購完成後，持股比將升至35.46%。
燁輝表示，本次參與燁聯私募，資金將直接挹注燁聯鋼鐵推動「高效節能環保電爐」、「熱軋與冷軋產線現代化、自動化及智能建置」、「高值化產品組合與碳鋼產能擴大」，以及「提升綠能使用率與循環經濟」等重大改造計畫。
燁輝指出，透過資金支持燁聯上游產線現代化與節能升級，可確保燁聯生產的電爐熱軋鋼捲，在加工性、表面品質及鍍層附著力等方面，完全匹配燁輝高階鍍烤產品需求，進一步實現低碳排與高品質並存的競爭優勢。
此外，本次私募資金也將用於改善燁聯鋼鐵財務結構、降低利息負擔並增強營運韌性，燁輝表示，隨著燁聯獲利能力提升及營運規模擴大，也將直接反映於燁輝採權益法認列的轉投資收益，形成「上游營運改善、下游料源穩定、整體獲利回饋」的互惠綜效。
paras_en: Yeh Hui (2023‑TW) held a major announcement today (23rd), stating it intends to subscribe for 134,000 private‑placement ordinary shares of Yeh Lian (9957‑TW) at a private‑placement price of NT$6 per share, amounting to an investment of NT$804 million. Yeh Hui currently holds a direct stake of 34.05% in Yeh Lian; after this subscription is completed, its ownership will increase to 35.46%.

Yeh Hui said the funds from this private placement will be directly injected into Yeh Lian Steel to drive major transformation projects, including “high‑efficiency, energy‑saving, environmentally‑friendly electric furnaces,” “modernization, automation and intelligent construction of hot‑rolling and cold‑rolling production lines,” “high‑value product mix and expansion of carbon‑steel capacity,” as well as “enhancing green‑energy utilization and circular‑economy initiatives.”

Yeh Hui pointed out that by supporting the modernization and energy‑saving upgrades of Yeh Lian’s upstream production lines, it can ensure that the electric‑furnace hot‑rolled steel coils produced by Yeh Lian meet Yeh Hui’s high‑end coating product requirements in terms of formability, surface quality and coating adhesion, thereby creating a competitive advantage that combines low carbon emissions with high quality.

In addition, the private‑placement capital will be used to improve Yeh Lian Steel’s financial structure, reduce interest burdens and strengthen operational resilience. Yeh Hui said that as Yeh Lian’s profitability improves and its operational scale expands, the benefits will be directly reflected in Yeh Hui’s equity‑method recognized investment income, creating a mutually beneficial effect of “upstream operational improvement, downstream material supply stability, and overall profit feedback.”

items.title: 研華北美市場BB值逾2 產能供不應求爆滿到明年下半年
items.title_en: Advantech North America Market BB Ratio Exceeds 2, Capacity Shortage Full Through Mid‑Next Year
paras: 工業電腦大廠研華(2395-TW)北美區總經理牛文中今(23)日表示，研華前8月整體接單出貨比(BB Ratio)目前約1.4，但北美區高達2.15，且預計到年底仍維持在2左右，由於需求強勁，目前北美廠區產能滿載、供不應求，預期產能爆滿情況將延續至明年下半年。
牛文中表示，北美客戶對研華的要求已延伸至未來發展藍圖，公司已針對明、後年已提前規劃，因此今年上半年北美Design Win專案量已超越去年全年的4億美元，預計下半年將持平甚至有機會更多，今年全年Design Win專案量可望較去年增加1倍以上，持續挹注未來業績表現。
目前研華在美國共有3大主要生產與營運基地，分別位於伊利諾州Ottawa、北加州Milpitas，以及最新落成啟用的南加州Tustin。其中，過往作為主要生產據點的Milpitas目前已產能超載，Tustin則已有部分產線投產，陸續分擔專案訂單需求，營運總部預計10月下旬正式開幕。
牛文中進一步指出，Tustin今年預計產能達1億美元，但仍不足以因應需求，明年產能將提升至3億美元，並持續透過加班及加速將北加州產能調度至南加州，以填補訂單缺口，預期產能滿載、供不應求的情況要到明年下半年才會舒緩。因應長期需求，研華也規畫在南加州進一步購地，擴充生產基地。
在地製造方面，牛文中表示，北美製造可滿足客戶在地化、供應鏈韌性及縮短交期需求，隨邊緣AI成長，加上在地服務、法遵及美國政策法規，帶動在地製造需求。透過在地研發、製造及交付，研華可提供深度客製化與在地支援，尤其軍工、金融等高機密性產業對美國製造需求較高。
研華北美南加州新總部坐落於加州Tustin ATEP園區，占地10英畝，總樓地板面積18.9萬平方英尺，總部大樓樓高6層，整體投資金額超過1億美元，園區涵蓋辦公室、組裝製造中心、倉儲、展示中心(Demo Room)及會議中心，新總部定位為商業與營運核心。
paras_en: Industrial computer giant Advantech (2395‑TW) North America regional manager Niu Wen‑zhong said on the 23rd that Advantech’s overall BB Ratio for the first eight months is about 1.4, but it reaches 2.15 in North America and is expected to stay around 2 through year‑end. Because demand is strong, the North American plants are running at full capacity and supply cannot meet demand, and this capacity crunch is expected to last until the second half of next year.

Niu explained that North American customers’ requirements now extend to future development roadmaps, and the company has already planned ahead for the next two years. Consequently, the Design‑Win project volume in North America in the first half of this year already surpassed the full‑year $400 million of last year, and the second half is expected to be flat or even higher. The total Design‑Win volume for the year could be more than double last year’s, continuously feeding future performance.

Advantech currently operates three major production and operations sites in the United States: Ottawa, Illinois; Milpitas in Northern California; and the newly completed Tustin site in Southern California. Milpitas, formerly the main production hub, is now over‑capacity, while Tustin has already brought some production lines online to gradually share the project order load, with the operations headquarters slated to officially open in late October.

Niu added that Tustin is expected to reach a production capacity of $100 million this year, which is still insufficient for demand. Capacity will be raised to $300 million next year, and the company will continue to use overtime and accelerate the shift of Northern California capacity to Southern California to fill the order gap. The situation of full capacity and supply shortage is not expected to ease until the second half of next year. To meet long‑term demand, Advantech also plans to purchase additional land in Southern California to expand the plant.

Regarding local manufacturing, Niu said that North American production can satisfy customers’ needs for localization, supply‑chain resilience and shorter lead times. With the growth of edge AI, together with local services, regulatory compliance and U.S. policy requirements, demand for domestic manufacturing is being driven. Through local R&D, manufacturing and delivery, Advantech can provide deep customization and on‑site support, especially for high‑confidentiality sectors such as defense and finance that have strong demand for U.S.‑made products.

Advantech’s new North America headquarters in Southern California is located in the ATEP campus in Tustin, California, covering 10 acres with a total floor area of 189,000 square feet across six stories. The overall investment exceeds $100 million. The campus includes offices, an assembly‑manufacturing center, warehousing, a demo room and a conference center, positioning the new headquarters as the core of its commercial and operational activities.

items.title: 散戶大軍回神！8月證券劃撥存款餘額飆破4.5兆元 創歷史新高
items.title_en: Retail Investors Rally! August Securities Transfer Deposit Balance Surges Past NT$4.5 Trillion, Hitting a Historic High
paras: 台灣央行今(23)日公布7月國內金融情況，一向被視為「散戶風向球」的證券劃撥存款餘額較上月飆增3889億元至4兆5712億元，創歷史新高，單月增加3889億元也創史上最大增額，同時，8月台股融資餘額增至7589億元，創單月次高，僅次於6月。
央行說明，證券劃撥存款餘額「處於蠻高水準」，反映投資人信心升溫，散戶8月在台股的成交占比從上月的48.9%回升至50.9%，而本國法人由12%降至 10.2%，僑外法人降至38.8%。
此外，由於AI相關電子出口相當暢旺，廠商收取貨款，使8月外匯存款期底餘額升至9兆6488億元，較上月續增566億元，並續創歷史新高。
另一方面，央行8月日平均貨幣總計數M1B和M2年增率分別下降為6.65%、6.79%，其中，M2年增率下降主要因外匯存款及活期儲蓄存款成長減緩；累計前8月平均M1B及M2年增率分別為7.71%、6.62%。
央行進一步提到，8月全體貨幣機構放款與投資期底餘額共57.4兆元，年增9.43%，創27年半來最大增幅，主要AI強勁需求下，製造業購地、建廠、購料等資金需求增加。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan released July domestic financial data today (23rd), showing that the securities transfer deposit balance—often seen as the "retail investor barometer"—jumped by NT$388.9 billion from the previous month to NT$4,571.2 billion, a historic peak. The monthly increase of NT$388.9 billion also marks the largest rise ever recorded, while August margin financing balances rose to NT$758.9 billion, the second‑largest monthly total after June.

The bank explained that the securities transfer deposit balance is "at a fairly high level," reflecting warming investor confidence. Retail investors' share of Taiwan‑stock trading rose from 48.9% in the prior month to 50.9% in August, while domestic institutional investors fell from 12% to 10.2% and foreign institutional investors dropped to 38.8%.

In addition, strong exports of AI‑related electronics boosted manufacturers' cash receipts, pushing the end‑of‑month foreign‑exchange deposit balance up to NT$9,648.8 billion in August, an increase of NT$56.6 billion from the previous month and a new historical high.

On the other hand, the central bank reported that the average daily M1B and M2 growth rates for August fell to 6.65% and 6.79% year‑over‑year, respectively. The slowdown in M2 growth was mainly due to a deceleration in foreign‑exchange deposits and demand‑deposit growth; the cumulative average growth rates for the first eight months were 7.71% for M1B and 6.62% for M2.

The bank further noted that total loans and investment balances across all monetary institutions reached NT$57.4 trillion at the end of August, a 9.43% year‑over‑year increase—the largest rise in 27½ years—driven by strong AI demand that spurred manufacturing firms to spend on land acquisition, plant construction, and material purchases.

items.title: 台股總市值5.3兆美元超車印度躍全球第4 神山單日貢獻逾1兆元
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Valuation Hits $5.3 Trillion, Overtakes India to Rank 4th Globally; TSMC Contributes Over NT$1 Trillion in One Day
paras: 台股今(23)日開高，雖呈高檔震盪，但在權值股領軍走揚下，終場仍上漲 357.12 點，以 48,157.29 點作收，再度改寫歷史新高紀錄，台灣資本市場的世界排名也出現歷史性突破，最新總市值衝上 5.3 兆美元，首度超越印度，躋身全球第 4 大股票市場。而最大的功臣莫過於護國神山台積電，單日就貢獻了超過新台幣 1 兆元的市值增幅。
根據國際財經數據網站《MarketCapWatch》截至今日下午 5 時的最新統計，台灣股市總市值達到約 5.3 兆美元，正式超越印度的 4.94 兆美元，榮登全球第 4 大股票市場。目前全球前三大股市分別為美國 82.7 兆美元、中國 21.22 兆美元及日本 8.59 兆美元。
全球第 6 至 10 名的資本市場，依序為英國 4.86 兆美元、韓國 4.5 兆美元、加拿大 4.45 兆美元、法國 3.08 兆美元以及德國 3 兆美元。台股不僅展現強勁的本土資金動能，在全球資本市場的戰略地位亦大幅提升。
台股這波市值暴衝的核心引擎即為權王台積電(2330-TW)，今日股價收在 2,500 元、大漲 40 元，市值衝高至 64.83 兆元，單日狂增約 1 兆元，不但為台股創高奠定基石，台積美元計算的市值2.05兆美元，也在《MarketCapWatch》全球個股市值中排名第7名。與排名第6的SpaceX(SPCX-US)市值2.08兆美元相去不遠。
在半導體與 AI 供應鏈族群拉抬下，上市前二十大個股排名也出現顯著變化，ABF 載板廠欣興(3037-TW)上漲 40 元收在 1,160 元，市值激增 655 億元，站上 1.9 兆元，並成功攀升至第 9 名，將南亞(1303-TW)擠至第 10 名。
散熱龍頭奇鋐(3017-TW)市值上揚314億元、來到 1.36 兆元，名次超越中信金(2891-TW)前進至第 15 名；被動元件大廠國巨*(2327-TW)市值小幅回升，超越緯穎(6669-TW)名列第 18 名。
傳產、金融族群今天普遍面臨回檔，南亞(1303-TW)市值縮水 317 億元；高價股川湖(2059-TW)大跌 280 元收在 12,390 元，市值下修至 1.18 兆元，為上市前二十大中跌幅最深個股。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks opened higher today (23rd) and, despite trading in a high‑range oscillation, ended up up 357.12 points, closing at 48,157.29 points, again setting a fresh all‑time high. Taiwan’s capital market achieved a historic breakthrough, with total market cap soaring to about $5.3 trillion, surpassing India for the first time and moving into the world’s fourth‑largest stock market. The biggest contributor was the “national guardian” TSMC, which alone added more than NT$1 trillion to market value in a single day.

According to the international finance data site MarketCapWatch, the latest figures as of 5 p.m. today show Taiwan’s total stock market value at roughly $5.3 trillion, officially overtaking India’s $4.94 trillion and claiming the fourth‑largest spot globally. The top three markets remain the United States at $82.7 trillion, China at $21.22 trillion and Japan at $8.59 trillion.

The world’s sixth‑through‑tenth‑largest capital markets are, in order, the United Kingdom ($4.86 trillion), South Korea ($4.5 trillion), Canada ($4.45 trillion), France ($3.08 trillion) and Germany ($3 trillion). Taiwan’s market not only shows strong domestic capital momentum but also markedly improves its strategic standing in the global capital arena.

The engine behind this market‑cap surge is the heavyweight TSMC (2330‑TW). Its share price closed at NT$2,500, up NT$40, pushing its market cap to NT$64.83 trillion – an increase of about NT$1 trillion in a single day. This not only laid the foundation for the market’s new high, but TSMC’s dollar‑denominated market cap of $2.05 trillion ranks it seventh worldwide on MarketCapWatch, close behind the sixth‑ranked SpaceX (SPCX‑US) at $2.08 trillion.

Riding the semiconductor and AI supply‑chain rally, the top‑20 listed stocks saw notable reshuffling. PCB maker Xinte (3037‑TW) rose NT$40 to close at NT$1,160, boosting its market cap by NT$65.5 billion to NT$1.9 trillion and climbing to the ninth spot, pushing Nanya (1303‑TW) down to tenth place.

Thermal‑solution leader Qihong (3017‑TW) saw its market cap rise NT$31.4 billion to NT$1.36 trillion, overtaking CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) to move up to the 15th position. Passive‑component giant Yageo (2327‑TW) saw a modest market‑cap rebound, surpassing Weiying (6669‑TW) to rank 18th.

Traditional industry and financial stocks generally faced pull‑backs today. Nanya’s market cap shrank by NT$31.7 billion; high‑price stock Chuanhu (2059‑TW) plunged NT$280 to close at NT$12,390, reducing its market cap to NT$1.18 trillion, making it the steepest‑declining stock among the pre‑listing top‑20.

items.title: 中華電信積極投入6G前瞻技術 林榮賜：6G將朝向AI原生網路發展
items.title_en: Chunghwa Telecom Actively Invests in Forward‑Looking 6G Technology; Lin Rong‑tsai: 6G Will Evolve Toward AI‑Native Networks
paras: 中華電信(2412-TW)與6G產業論壇(6GIF)及台灣資通產業標準協會(TAICS)於今(23)日舉辦2026 6G Summit Taipei國際高峰會。中華電信積極投入5G-Advanced及6G前瞻技術，總經理林榮賜也指出，6G將進一步朝向AI原生(AI-Native)網路發展。
林榮賜表示，6G的突破不在於單一硬體或軟體技術，而是在於打造跨產業協作的次世代數位生態系。相較於5G著重高速率、低延遲及大規模物聯網，6G將朝向AI原生網路發展。
林榮賜進一步指出，AI從應用層走向通訊基礎設施，並結合AI-RAN、整合感測與通訊(ISAC)、非地面網路(NTN)及低空經濟等創新技術，將數位連結從地面延伸至空中，開啟萬物智慧聯網的新時代。他認為，台灣因有頂尖的半導體實力及完整的ICT產業鏈，有望成為全球6G創新的合作夥伴。
因此中華電信長期積極投入5G-Advanced及6G前瞻技術，持續參與3GPP國際標準組織與NGMN等國際產業聯盟，並投入相關技術標準制定工作，與全球電信業者、設備商及研究機構交流合作，共同推動掌握前瞻網路技術與產業趨勢。
中華電信也於2026 6G Summit Taipei國際高峰會中，展出「多軌衛星通訊服務」，整合高軌、中軌、低軌衛星及衛星通話等通訊能力，並與既有地面網路協同運作，提供完整多軌衛星通訊解決方案。透過不同軌道衛星在涵蓋範圍、傳輸能力及應用情境上互補，逐步建構涵蓋「海、地、星、空」多層次的通訊備援架構。
中華電信表示，面對未來6G天地融合及AI原生網路發展趨勢，將持續深化國際合作，投入標準制定與關鍵技術研發，並配合台灣未來6G頻譜規劃與釋出時程，推動新世代通訊技術落地應用。
paras_en: Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW) together with the 6G Industry Forum (6GIF) and the Taiwan ICT Industry Standards Association (TAICS) held the 2026 6G Summit Taipei international summit today (the 23rd). Chunghwa Telecom is actively investing in 5G‑Advanced and forward‑looking 6G technologies, and its general manager Lin Rong‑tsai noted that 6G will further develop toward AI‑native networks.

Lin said that the breakthrough of 6G does not lie in any single hardware or software technology, but in building a next‑generation digital ecosystem through cross‑industry collaboration. Compared with 5G, which focuses on high speed, low latency and massive IoT, 6G will move toward AI‑native networking.

Lin further explained that AI will shift from the application layer to the communications infrastructure, integrating AI‑RAN, integrated sensing and communications (ISAC), non‑terrestrial networks (NTN) and the low‑altitude economy, extending digital connectivity from the ground to the sky and ushering in a new era of intelligent networking for everything. He believes Taiwan, with its world‑class semiconductor strength and complete ICT supply chain, is poised to become a global partner for 6G innovation.

Accordingly, Chunghwa Telecom has long been actively investing in 5G‑Advanced and forward‑looking 6G technologies, continuously participating in the 3GPP international standards body and industry alliances such as NGMN, contributing to related standards work, and collaborating with global operators, equipment vendors and research institutions to jointly drive the adoption of cutting‑edge network technologies and industry trends.

At the 2026 6G Summit Taipei, Chunghwa Telecom also showcased a “multi‑orbit satellite communication service,” integrating high‑, medium‑ and low‑orbit satellites as well as satellite voice capabilities, working in tandem with existing terrestrial networks to provide a complete multi‑orbit satellite communication solution. By leveraging the complementary coverage, capacity and use‑case strengths of different orbital satellites, it is gradually building a multi‑layer communication redundancy architecture spanning sea, land, space and air.

Chunghwa Telecom said that in response to the future convergence of 6G terrestrial‑satellite networks and AI‑native networking, it will continue to deepen international cooperation, invest in standards development and key technology R&D, and align with Taiwan’s upcoming 6G spectrum planning and release schedule to bring next‑generation communications technologies to market.

items.title: IonQ大漲5%量子運算再突破 攜手輝達推升股價
items.title_en: IonQ surges 5% as quantum computing breakthrough and partnership with Nvidia lift stock
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，IonQ(IONQ-US)股價周三(23日)大漲5%，此前公司宣布量子運算領域取得突破，並與AI晶片大廠輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)展開新的合作。
IonQ宣布將把名為Superion 256的量子電腦安裝在輝達位於波士頓的加速量子研究中心(Accelerated Quantum Research Center)，並直接連接至這家AI晶片巨頭的基礎設施。
IonQ董事長暨執行長Niccolo de Masi在聲明中表示，「我們認為，這是混合量子－經典運算令人振奮的時代起點。」
兩家公司將利用這套系統進行金融模型與投資組合最佳化研究，以及用於藥物開發的化學研究。
IonQ股價同樣受到周二宣布的一項技術突破提振。該公司表示，其系統現在能夠利用單一標準CPU偵測並修正錯誤。
IonQ表示，這項突破「消除了容錯量子運算的一大瓶頸」。
量子運算類股今年以來波動劇烈。IBM(IBM-US)、D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US)、Rigetti Computing(RGTI-US)與Infleqtion(INFQ-US)4月宣布已與美國商務部簽署意向書，將獲得研究與開發計畫的資金，帶動量子運算股大幅上漲。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that IonQ (IONQ-US) shares jumped 5% on Wednesday (the 23rd) after the company announced a breakthrough in quantum computing and a new collaboration with AI chip giant Nvidia (NVDA-US).
IonQ said it will install its quantum computer called Superion 256 at Nvidia’s Accelerated Quantum Research Center in Boston, directly connecting to the AI‑chip giant’s infrastructure.
IonQ chairman and CEO Niccolo de Masi said in a statement, "We believe this marks the exciting beginning of the hybrid quantum‑classical computing era."
The two companies will use the system to research financial models and portfolio optimization, as well as chemical research for drug development.
IonQ’s stock was also buoyed by a technical breakthrough announced on Tuesday, with the company saying its system can now detect and correct errors using a single standard CPU.
IonQ said the breakthrough "removes a major bottleneck for fault‑tolerant quantum computing."

Quantum‑computing stocks have been highly volatile this year. IBM (IBM-US), D‑Wave Quantum (QBTS-US), Rigetti Computing (RGTI-US) and Infleqtion (INFQ-US) announced in April that they signed letters of intent with the U.S. Department of Commerce to receive funding for research and development, driving a sharp rally in quantum‑computing equities.

items.title: 「記憶體不缺」成空頭新論據 大賣空貝瑞加碼放空美光、Nebius
items.title_en: "Memory Not Scarce" Becomes New Bearish Thesis, Burry Expands Short on Micron, Nebius
paras: 電影《大賣空》真實原型、知名空頭投資人麥可貝瑞 (Michael Burry)再度擴大對半導體及AI相關股票的看空布局，將記憶體供給可能快速增加視為核心交易邏輯。貝瑞近日在Substack發文表示，他進一步加碼做空美光科技 (MU-US)、Nebius Group (NBIS-US)、iShares半導體ETF (SOXX)及Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US)，並形容這批新增空頭部位「規模不小」。
貝瑞此次加碼的直接背景，是宏碁 (2353-TW) 董事長暨執行長陳俊聖近期對記憶體供需的判斷。陳俊聖指出，部分主流記憶體產品的供應狀況已經改善，DDR4甚至出現「賣家多於買家」的情況，同時中國大陸記憶體業者持續增加產能，可能對市場價格形成壓力。貝瑞在9月22日的交易更新中引用這番說法，並表示雖然該消息是在記憶體股大漲前發布，因此解讀仍存在不確定性，但其內容「與我所相信的判斷相吻合」。
陳俊聖的看法與目前部分記憶體業者對供需前景的說法存在差異。他表示，DDR4及主流DDR5的供應已不像市場普遍認知般緊張，真正仍處於短缺狀態的主要是部分高階產品，例如LPDDR5X-9600等。宏碁同時預期，受到記憶體、SSD等關鍵零組件成本高漲影響，PC產品價格在2026年第4季仍可能上漲約5%至20%，而整體PC價格可能在2027年年中左右觸頂，之後於下半年開始回落。
貝瑞的核心論點，是目前記憶體市場的供應緊張部分來自產能配置錯位，而不完全是需求永久性提升所造成。他認為，隨著三星電子、SK海力士及美光等主要供應商為滿足AI資料中心對高頻寬記憶體(HBM)的強勁需求，部分傳統DRAM產能被轉移至HBM，使一般DRAM供應一度受到擠壓。
在貝瑞的判斷中，隨著記憶體廠商逐步恢復傳統DRAM產能，加上中國記憶體業者持續擴大供應，「正常RAM」產量將逐漸回升，原本的供需缺口可能收窄，並進一步轉化為價格下行壓力。近期中國記憶體產業的擴張也提供了這項論點的背景。中國長鑫存儲科技(CXMT)近期宣布第五代記憶體晶片平台已進入量產，並推出24Gb LPDDR5X產品；該平台透過製程改進，使單片晶圓的晶粒產量較上一代至少提高50%。
CXMT的擴產並非單一事件。路透近期報導指出，CXMT正計畫進一步進軍NAND Flash市場，以因應AI伺服器帶動的記憶體需求，並將與三星電子、SK海力士及美光等主要業者形成更直接的競爭。這意味著中國記憶體產能的增加，可能成為未來全球供需平衡的重要變數。
不過，市場對記憶體供應是否已經進入全面反轉階段仍存在明顯分歧。路透近期報導指出，一些較小型的手機及筆電業者仍在為至少持續至2027年的記憶體短缺做準備，部分業界預期供需失衡甚至可能延續至2030年以後。SK海力士也曾警告，2027年可能是產能供應最吃緊的一年。
與此同時，市場對美光的基本面預期仍然強勁。美光最近公布的財報顯示，財政第3季營收達414.6億美元，遠高於去年同期的93億美元，毛利率更達84.6%；公司預估財政第4季營收約500億美元，並預定在9月30日公布財報。這些數據顯示，當前記憶體價格與AI需求仍為美光帶來強勁的營收及獲利動能，也是貝瑞空頭論點需要面對的市場背景。
貝瑞對半導體產業的看空布局也並非近期才開始。2026年6月底，他已公開揭露放空輝達 (NVDA-US)、應用材料 (AMAT-US)及iShares半導體ETF，並將SOXX相關看跌選擇權展期至2027年3月。當時他也認為AI及半導體類股的上漲已經累積相當大的估值風險。
到了7月初，貝瑞進一步直接放空美光，揭露的進場價格約為每股1,051.87美元。他當時表示，美光看跌選擇權的權利金過於昂貴，因此選擇直接建立股票空頭部位，並稱若未來波動率下降、選擇權價格變得更合理，才可能進一步透過看跌期權增加押注。
這次新增部位則讓貝瑞的看空範圍進一步延伸至AI基礎設施業者Nebius及更廣泛的半導體ETF。貝瑞不只押注單一記憶體企業，也透過SOXX將交易延伸至整體半導體產業，同時維持對Palantir的空頭曝險。
值得注意的是，貝瑞近期對半導體市場的判斷並非單純認為AI需求會消失，而是認為資金可能從半導體類股轉向其他科技領域。他在最新交易文章中指出，記憶體短缺與AI採用的敘事正在吸收市場大量資金，並認為半導體類股可能出現資金輪動。不過，他也承認主要指數持續創新高，使得短期內直接判斷市場頂部並不容易。
市場實際走勢則暫時沒有完全配合貝瑞的空頭押注。9月22日，美光股價收漲5%至1,096.16美元，Nebius上漲約1.43%至236.12美元，Palantir上漲約1.04%至184.99美元，SOXX則上漲約2.4%至572.78美元。也就是說，貝瑞宣布加碼空頭部位後，相關資產當天反而普遍走高。
散戶情緒同樣呈現與貝瑞不同的方向。Stocktwits資料顯示，美光的零售投資人情緒由中性轉為看多，SOXX的散戶情緒也位於看多區間；Nebius同樣呈現偏多情緒，只有Palantir的散戶情緒偏空。美光股價在9月22日上漲5%至1,096.16美元，9月以來累計漲幅約14%。
不過，到了9月23日盤中，市場反應開始出現分化。Palantir一度上漲約2%，Nebius則下跌約2%，美光一度下跌約1%，SOXX下跌約1%，顯示投資人並未以一致方向回應貝瑞的最新交易。
因此，貝瑞與市場目前真正的分歧，並非AI需求是否存在，而是AI需求成長速度能否持續高於記憶體供給擴張速度。若HBM需求持續吸收大量產能，傳統DRAM供應恢復速度可能受到限制；反之，如果中國新增產能、既有記憶體廠恢復一般DRAM產能的速度超過需求增長，價格就可能面臨更大壓力。
這也使2027年成為市場觀察記憶體週期的重要時間窗口。宏碁方面預期PC價格可能在2027年年中左右觸頂、下半年開始回落；部分記憶體業者及產業研究則認為AI伺服器需求仍可能讓供應持續吃緊。
對貝瑞而言，這場交易最終押注的是記憶體供需週期能否由短缺轉向供應增加，而不是單純押注AI產業需求消失。隨著CXMT等中國供應商擴產、三星電子、SK海力士及美光持續調整HBM與傳統DRAM之間的產能配置，以及AI資料中心持續拉動HBM需求，未來記憶體價格究竟會延續高檔，還是如貝瑞所預期般在供應增加後轉跌，將成為半導體市場下一階段的重要觀察焦點。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the famed short-seller whose story inspired the movie "The Big Short," is again widening his bearish bets on semiconductor and AI‑related stocks, using the prospect of a rapid increase in memory supply as the core of his trade. In a recent Substack post, Burry said he is adding short positions in Micron Technology (MU‑US), Nebius Group (NBIS‑US), the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) and Palantir Technologies (PLTR‑US), describing the new shorts as "not small in size."

The immediate trigger for Burry's latest add‑on was the recent comments by Acer (2353‑TW) chairman and CEO Chen Jun‑sheng on memory supply‑demand. Chen said that supply of several mainstream memory products has improved, with DDR4 even seeing "more sellers than buyers," and that Chinese memory makers are continuing to add capacity, which could pressure prices. Burry quoted this in his September 22 trading update, noting that the comment came before a big rally in memory stocks, so its interpretation is uncertain, but that it "matches the judgment I hold."

Chen's view differs from that of some memory makers on the supply‑demand outlook. He said DDR4 and mainstream DDR5 are not as tight as the market generally believes; the real shortages are limited to high‑end products such as LPDDR5X‑9600. Acer also expects that, because of rising costs for memory, SSDs and other key components, PC prices could rise 5%‑20% in Q4 2026, with overall PC pricing possibly peaking around mid‑2027 and then falling in the second half of the year.

Burry's core argument is that the current tightness in the memory market stems partly from a misallocation of capacity rather than a permanent surge in demand. He believes that major suppliers such as Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron are shifting some traditional DRAM capacity to high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) to meet strong AI data‑center demand, squeezing ordinary DRAM supply.

In Burry's view, as memory makers gradually restore traditional DRAM output and Chinese producers keep expanding supply, "normal RAM" production will rise, narrowing the supply‑demand gap and creating downward price pressure. Recent expansion in China's memory industry underpins this thesis. China’s CXMT recently announced that its fifth‑generation memory chip platform has entered mass production and launched a 24‑Gb LPDDR5X product; process improvements boost wafer‑level chip output by at least 50% over the previous generation.

CXMT's capacity boost is not an isolated event. Reuters reported that CXMT plans to move further into the NAND‑Flash market to meet AI‑server‑driven memory demand, putting it in more direct competition with Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. This suggests that China's growing memory capacity could become a key variable in the global supply‑demand balance.

However, market participants remain divided on whether memory supply has fully turned around. Reuters noted that some smaller smartphone and laptop makers are still preparing for a memory shortage that could last at least until 2027, with some industry voices warning the imbalance could extend beyond 2030. SK Hynix has also cautioned that 2027 may be the year of the tightest capacity supply.

At the same time, expectations for Micron's fundamentals remain strong. Micron's latest earnings showed Q3 revenue of $41.46 billion, far above last year’s $9.3 billion, with a gross margin of 84.6%. The company forecasts Q4 revenue of roughly $50 billion and will release its next earnings report on September 30. These figures indicate that current memory prices and AI demand are still driving robust revenue and profit momentum for Micron, a backdrop Burry must contend with.

Burry's bearish stance on the semiconductor sector is not new. By the end of June 2026 he had publicly disclosed short positions in Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF, and rolled over SOXX put options to March 2027. At that time he argued that AI‑related and semiconductor stocks had accumulated significant valuation risk.

In early July, Burry went further by shorting Micron directly, entering at about $1,051.87 per share. He said Micron’s put premiums were too expensive, so he chose to establish a naked short position, adding that he might increase exposure via puts if volatility fell and option prices became more reasonable.

The new positions extend Burry’s short exposure to AI‑infrastructure player Nebius and the broader semiconductor ETF. He is not only betting against a single memory company but also using SOXX to target the entire semiconductor industry while maintaining a short on Palantir.

It is worth noting that Burry’s recent view of the semiconductor market is not that AI demand will disappear, but that capital may rotate out of semiconductor stocks into other tech areas. In his latest trading note he said the narrative of memory shortages and AI adoption is soaking up a lot of market money, and that semiconductor equities could see a capital rotation. He also acknowledged that major indices are still hitting fresh highs, making short‑term tops hard to pinpoint.

Market action has not fully aligned with Burry’s short bets. On September 22, Micron closed up 5% at $1,096.16, Nebius rose about 1.43% to $236.12, Palantir gained roughly 1.04% to $184.99, and SOXX climbed about 2.4% to 572.78. In other words, the assets he announced he was adding to his short side actually rose on the same day.

Retail sentiment moved in the opposite direction. Stocktwits data show Micron’s retail investor sentiment shifting from neutral to bullish, SOXX’s retail sentiment also in bullish territory, Nebius similarly bullish, while only Palantir’s retail sentiment remained bearish. Micron’s price has risen 5% on September 22 to $1,096.16 and is up about 14% since the start of September.

However, by mid‑day on September 23 the market response began to diverge. Palantir briefly jumped about 2%, Nebius fell roughly 2%, Micron dipped about 1% at one point, and SOXX also slipped about 1%, indicating investors were not moving in lockstep with Burry’s latest trades.

Thus the real split between Burry and the market is not whether AI demand exists, but whether AI‑driven demand growth can stay ahead of the expansion in memory supply. If HBM demand continues to soak up large capacity, the recovery of traditional DRAM supply may be constrained; conversely, if Chinese new capacity and existing memory fabs restore DRAM output faster than demand grows, prices could face stronger downward pressure.

This makes 2027 a key window for watching the memory cycle. Acer expects PC prices to peak around mid‑2027 and then fall in the second half of the year; some memory makers and industry analysts believe AI‑server demand could keep supply tight.

For Burry, the trade ultimately bets on whether the memory supply‑demand cycle can shift from shortage to oversupply, rather than simply betting on the disappearance of AI demand. As Chinese suppliers like CXMT scale up, Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron adjust capacity between HBM and traditional DRAM, and AI data centers keep pulling HBM, the future path of memory prices—whether they stay elevated or fall as Burry predicts after supply ramps up—will be a focal point for the next phase of the semiconductor market.

items.title: 美數據火熱、Fed放鷹 10年期美債殖利率升破5.1% 創19年新高
items.title_en: U.S. Data Hot, Fed Hawkish, 10‑Year Treasury Yield Breaks 5.1% to 19‑Year High
paras: 美債週三 (23 日) 遭遇新一波拋售潮，10 年期殖利率一度升至 5.129%，創 2007 年 7 月以來新高。9 月企業活動加速擴張、價格壓力升高，加上聯準會 (Fed) 官員暗示可能繼續升息，促使交易員提高對 10 月升息的押注。
標普全球公布，美國 9 月企業活動連續第 4 個月加速擴張，增速為 2021 年 7 月以來最快，製造業與服務業產出均成長。標普全球市場財智商業經濟學家 Williamson 表示，若排除疫情封鎖解除後的需求反彈，這是 2015 年初以來最顯著的企業活動改善。
經濟走強的同時，企業成本也持續攀升。
標普全球指出，燃料與運輸費用上漲，推動 9 月商品及服務業投入成本增加，整體價格漲幅達 2022 年 10 月以來最高。Williamson 認為，成本上升可能進一步推高未來幾個月的售價與通膨。
數據公布後，市場對 Fed 再度升息的預期升高。CME FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預估 Fed 10 月升息 1 碼的機率，從前一日約 55% 升至近 70%。
美債殖利率隨之攀升。報導所引述的最新報價顯示，10 年期殖利率上升 18.1 個基點至 5.129%；5 年期上升 16.8 個基點至 5.010%，同樣是 2007 年 7 月以來首次突破 5%。30 年期上升 10.7 個基點至 5.410%，對利率政策較敏感的 2 年期則上升 13.1 個基點至 4.908%。
Fed 理事巴爾 (Michael Barr) 也表示，實現長期 2% 通膨目標的風險已增加，因此需要「重新校準貨幣政策」。他支持 Fed 上週升息，並認為在其基本情境下，可能仍須進一步調整政策，才能讓通膨及時回到目標。
油價反彈則為債市增添壓力。原油價格週三結束連續 5 天跌勢，市場對美伊外交取得進展的期待降溫。
川普週二曾表示，美方代表與伊朗代表團談了 3 小時，並形容會談「非常好」；但美國國務卿盧比歐週三表示，他不會將這次會談稱為「重大突破」，而是視為過去對話的延續。伊朗總統裴澤斯基安則表示，伊朗願意對話與談判，但不接受以武力語言施壓。
paras_en: U.S. Treasuries on Wednesday (the 23rd) faced a new wave of selling, with the 10‑year yield briefly climbing to 5.129%, a fresh peak since July 2007. September corporate activity accelerated, price pressures rose, and Fed officials hinted further rate hikes, prompting traders to increase bets on an October hike.

S&P Global reported that U.S. September corporate activity accelerated for the fourth consecutive month, the fastest pace since July 2021, with both manufacturing and services output growing. S&P Global Market Intelligence economist Williamson said that excluding the post‑pandemic demand rebound, this is the most significant improvement in corporate activity since early 2015.
While the economy strengthens, corporate costs continue to climb.

S&P Global noted that higher fuel and transportation costs drove up input costs for goods and services in September, with overall price increases reaching the highest level since October 2022. Williamson believes the cost rise could further push up prices and inflation in the coming months.

After the data release, market expectations for another Fed hike rose. The CME FedWatch tool showed traders’ probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in October climbing from about 55% the day before to nearly 70%.

Treasury yields rose accordingly. The latest quotes cited in the report show the 10‑year yield up 18.1 basis points to 5.129%; the 5‑year up 16.8 basis points to 5.010%, also breaking above 5% for the first time since July 2007. The 30‑year rose 10.7 basis points to 5.410%, and the rate‑sensitive 2‑year climbed 13.1 basis points to 4.908%.

Fed Governor Michael Barr also said the risk of achieving the long‑term 2% inflation target has increased, requiring a “re‑calibration of monetary policy.” He supported last week’s rate hike and said that under the baseline scenario further policy adjustments may still be needed to bring inflation back to target in a timely manner.
A rebound in oil prices added pressure to the bond market. Crude oil ended a five‑day decline on Wednesday, as market expectations for progress in U.S.–Iran diplomacy cooled.

Trump on Tuesday said the U.S. delegation had a three‑hour meeting with the Iranian team and described it as “very good”; but Secretary of State Antony Blinken on Wednesday said he would not call the talks a “major breakthrough,” viewing them as a continuation of past dialogue. Iran’s President Ebrahim Raisi said Iran is willing to talk and negotiate but will not accept pressure through forceful language.

items.title: 輝達挑戰新高漲勢暫歇 Google AI晶片帶來難題
items.title_en: Nvidia's Challenge to New Highs Pauses as Google AI Chip Poses Problem
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，一個熟悉的問題再次困擾輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)。這家晶片製造商的股價近期再次挑戰歷史新高，但周三(23日)攻勢暫歇，而Google正是問題的一部分。
輝達周三收跌1.4%至225.51美元。該股近期難以突破235.74美元的歷史收盤高點，這項在5月14日創下的紀錄。
部分原因在於整體半導體產業面臨的宏觀經濟因素，費城半導體指數過去3個月下跌5.9%。但輝達也一直需要應對市場對競爭對手蠶食其AI晶片主導地位的疑慮。
最大威脅來自Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google及其TPU，這款晶片是與博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)合作設計。儘管輝達與Google之間的競爭通常相當友好，但投資人仍密切關注大型企業究竟採用哪些晶片。
因此當科技媒體《The Information》報導，Anthropic正洽談向Stream Data Centers租用最高1GW的運算容量，而其中大部分將由TPU提供運算能力，這可能讓市場感到不安。
就在一周前，由10家銀行組成的銀團同意向Crux AI提供220億美元貸款。這家雲端運算新創公司由黑石(Blackstone)與Alphabet支持，這筆資金將用於購買TPU。
不過，這未必是輝達面臨的重大問題。畢竟，Anthropic近期才與雲端服務商Lambda簽署價值350億美元的雲端運算協議，將採用輝達晶片。另據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic也與另一家獲輝達支持的新型雲端服務商Nscale簽署450億美元的協議。
但這再次提醒市場，包括Anthropic在內的大型客戶，正持續設法降低對輝達的依賴。今年8月，Anthropic證實正在組建內部晶片團隊，跟隨ChatGPT開發商OpenAI的腳步。
正如《巴隆》先前報導，輝達正透過支持開源AI社群來反擊，以擴大客戶群。不過，要取代一家Anthropic，需要非常多小型AI公司，而這正是輝達持續面臨的壓力。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that a familiar problem is once again troubling Nvidia (NVDA-US). The chip maker’s stock has recently been testing all‑time highs, but its rally stalled on Wednesday (the 23rd), and Google is part of the issue.
Nvidia closed down 1.4% on Wednesday at $225.51. The shares have struggled to break above the historic closing high of $235.74 set on May 14.

One reason is the broader semiconductor sector’s macro‑economic headwinds, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 5.9% over the past three months. Nvidia also faces concerns that competitors could erode its AI‑chip dominance.

The biggest threat comes from Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google and its TPU, a chip co‑designed with Broadcom (AVGO-US). Although competition between Nvidia and Google is usually fairly friendly, investors are watching closely which chips large enterprises choose.

Thus, when tech outlet The Information reported that Anthropic is negotiating to lease up to 1 GW of compute capacity from Stream Data Centers, most of which will be powered by TPUs, the market grew uneasy.
Just a week earlier, a syndicate of ten banks agreed to lend Crux AI $22 billion. The cloud‑computing startup, backed by Blackstone and Alphabet, will use the funds to purchase TPUs.

However, this may not be a major problem for Nvidia. Anthropic recently signed a $35 billion cloud‑compute deal with Lambda that will use Nvidia chips, and, according to the Wall Street Journal, also signed a $45 billion agreement with Nscale, another new cloud provider backed by Nvidia.

But the episode underscores that large customers, including Anthropic, are actively trying to reduce reliance on Nvidia. In August, Anthropic confirmed it is building an internal chip team, following OpenAI’s path.

As Baron previously reported, Nvidia is fighting back by supporting the open‑source AI community to broaden its customer base. Yet replacing a player like Anthropic would require many small AI firms, a pressure Nvidia continues to face.

items.title_en: Iran Proposes Reopening the Strait of Hormuz, U.S. Rejects
paras: 多家外媒週三 (23日) 報導，美國與伊朗在聯合國大會場邊舉行間接談判期間，伊朗提出重新開放荷姆茲海峽，但遭美方拒絕。美國談判代表表示，德黑蘭並不控制這條水道，並質疑伊朗是否有權提出這項條件。
這場談判在紐約不同房間、分別進行。美國特使魏科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 與川普女婿庫許納 (Jared Kushner) 同處一室，伊朗外交部長阿拉奇 (Abbas Araghchi) 則在另一個房間，由卡達調停人員往返傳話。
伊朗在談判中要求美國於一週內回應其公開提出的條件。
根據伊朗國營媒體 IRIB，德黑蘭的訴求包括立即解除美國的海上封鎖、儘速返還遭凍結的伊朗資產，以及結束針對所有「抵抗陣線」的戰爭。
這是美伊雙方自 6 月中旬以來首輪談判。以色列未派代表參加。以色列今年 2 月底與美國共同對伊朗發動軍事行動，但自 4 月以來大致停止空襲。
報導引述知情人士表示，在聯合國大會結束前，美伊仍可能舉行更多間接會談。不過，調停方正等待美國總統川普決定，是繼續推進談判，還是改採其他途徑。
川普週二在聯合國大會發表演說，對伊朗發出強硬警告，稱德黑蘭若不接受結束戰爭的協議，他可能「殲滅伊斯蘭共和國」，美國國務卿盧比歐週三在紐約告訴記者，川普總統「有很多選擇，包括軍事選項」。
伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian) 週三在第81屆聯合國大會發表演說。
他表示，伊朗願意談判與合作，但不會接受以強權、制裁或軍事威脅迫使其讓步，和平必須建立在公平、正義、尊嚴和各國平等權利的基礎上。
裴澤斯基安強調，伊朗維護國家安全、主權和和平利用核子技術的立場，認為自身防禦力量是避免外部威脅的重要保障，同時否認以霸權方式追求安全。
他批評一些國家在伊朗核問題、以色列及巴勒斯坦問題上的「雙重標準」，認為持續佔領、侵略和不公會加劇地區衝突。佩澤希齊揚表示，戰爭和軍事力量不能取代國際法、外交與政治對話，他呼籲透過區域合作實現共同安全。
布蘭特原油期貨週三上漲 3.83 美元或 3.86%，收在每桶 103.08 美元；西德州原油期貨上漲 1.64 美元或 1.81%，收在每桶 92.16 美元。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported on Wednesday (the 23rd) that during indirect talks between the United States and Iran held beside the UN General Assembly hall, Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz, but the U.S. refused. The U.S. negotiator said Tehran does not control the waterway and questioned whether Iran has the right to set such a condition.

The talks took place in separate rooms in New York. U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and former President Trump’s son‑in‑law Jared Kushner were in the same room, while Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi was in another room, with Qatari mediators shuttling messages between them.
Iran demanded that the United States respond within a week to the conditions it publicly presented.

According to Iran’s state media IRIB, Tehran’s demands include the immediate lifting of the U.S. maritime blockade, the swift return of frozen Iranian assets, and an end to the war against all “resistance fronts.”

This is the first round of talks between the U.S. and Iran since mid‑June. Israel sent no representatives. Israel jointly launched a military operation against Iran with the United States at the end of February, but has largely ceased air strikes since April.

Sources quoted in the report say that more indirect meetings between the U.S. and Iran could still occur before the UN General Assembly adjourns. However, the mediators are waiting for President Trump to decide whether to continue pushing the negotiations forward or to pursue other avenues.

President Trump delivered a speech at the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, issuing a hard‑line warning to Iran that if Tehran does not accept an agreement to end the war, he could “annihilate the Islamic Republic.” U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken told reporters in New York on Wednesday that the president “has many options, including military ones.”
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian spoke at the 81st UN General Assembly on Wednesday.

He said Iran is willing to negotiate and cooperate, but will not accept being forced to concede by power, sanctions or military threats; peace must be built on fairness, justice, dignity and equal rights for all nations.

Pezeshkian emphasized Iran’s stance of safeguarding national security, sovereignty and the peaceful use of nuclear technology, arguing that its own defensive capabilities are a key guarantee against external threats, while denying any hegemonic pursuit of security.

He criticized what he called “double standards” by some countries on Iran’s nuclear issue, as well as the Israel‑Palestine question, saying continued occupation, aggression and injustice will exacerbate regional conflict. Pezeshkian said war and military force cannot replace international law, diplomacy and political dialogue, and called for regional cooperation to achieve collective security.
Brent crude futures rose $3.83, or 3.86%, on Wednesday to close at $103.08 a barrel; West Texas Intermediate crude rose $1.64, or 1.81%, to close at $92.16 a barrel.
